character.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production game character walking SPRITE SHEET, single sheet exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, transparent background. Primary request: a friendly original gender-neutral schoolchild explorer for a Japanese elementary English directions map. Short dark hair, mint green T-shirt, navy shorts, yellow small backpack, red sneakers, full body. Consistent orthographic slightly overhead view (RPG map character). Each cell same size, character centered and feet baseline identical, generous padding between figures. Row 1: facing SOUTH toward viewer; row 2: facing WEST left profile; row 3: facing EAST right profile; row 4: facing NORTH away from viewer, backpack visible. In EACH row four animation frames left to right: standing neutral; walking left foot forward and right arm forward; passing neutral with feet together; walking right foot forward and left arm forward. All 16 figures exactly same character, scale, outfit, head size, fixed direction per row. Polished children's textbook flat illustration, clear bold outlines, 2D, friendly. No grid lines, no text, no props, no ground or shadow. Actual transparent background. Exact aligned 4x4 layout suitable for equal-cell CSS sprite animation.
character.processing: Mechanical alpha-boundary extraction and equal-size packing; 128x160 transparent frames. Generated source remains in the imagegen output directory.
